subject: general
question: Which foods is a good source of vitamin B12?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meats**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meats **is a good source of **vitamin B12**.
 
• This essential vitamin is primarily found in **animal-derived foods**, making meat an important dietary source for individuals following a non-vegetarian diet.
 
• Vitamin B12 plays a crucial role in various bodily functions, including the** formation of red blood cells, DNA synthesis, and nerve function.**
 
• However, for individuals following a vegetarian or vegan diet, other sources of vitamin B12, such as fortified foods or supplements, may be necessary to ensure adequate intake.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Vitamin B12,** scientifically known as cobalamin, is a **water-soluble vitamin** that belongs to the group of B vitamins.
 
• It plays a crucial role in metabolism and is essential for various bodily functions.
 
• Animals require vitamin B12 as a **cofactor in DNA synthesis**, as well as in the metabolism of fatty acids and amino acids.
 
• In humans, vitamin B12 is vital for the normal functioning of the nervous system, primarily due to its involvement in the synthesis of myelin. It also contributes to the maturation of red blood cells in the bone marrow, thereby supporting the circulatory system.
 
• Unlike animals, plants do not require cobalamin for their metabolic processes and utilize enzymes that do not rely on it.
 
• Vitamin B12 is distinguished as the most chemically complex among all vitamins. Notably, for humans, it is the only vitamin that must be obtained from animal-derived foods or supplements.
